title: Fool the judge on a task
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Write a submission meant to make the judge accept work that does not do what the task asks. If the judge accepts it, the cheat joins the tamper set as a case written outside Knos. If the judge refuses it, nothing is paid.
evidence: a pull request of yours on a funded task whose judge verdict was accepted, and a maintainer's note that the accepted work does not do what the task asks (docs/TAMPER.md)
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
